Streaming chat completion where the assistant responds with a tool call across multiple chunks

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather in NYC?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city and state, e.g. New York, NY\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chatStream(req: _req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
